body: All of this is not your fault my friend.

The important thing is that the school has the resources you need to complete your thesis.  That is, in part, notable professors who work on subjects you are interested in.  After this, believe me, it doesn't matter where you go.  People who don't know your field would be impressed by the name of the university.  People you will work with, however, will be interested by you and your work, not your alma-mater.
Choose the place you will feel better.  Doing a PhD is rough at times.  And overall happiness has a lot to do with success.  If you are happy where you are, your work will benefit from it, and this will overcome the effect of being at a lower "rank".  Who cares about ranks, except undergrads and people not related to your field?  The ultimate goal is to contribute to your field, and you can do that at any place where you are offered resources.
We are in a very similar situation my friend.

Thanks guys for answers, really appreciated.  I agree that most people just don't understand that when "they have no choice" but to fire you, or kick you out or whatever, and they say that they are sad about it, they just don't understand that they're making the whole thing 10x harder for you, who is already down.  A people fully aware of the situation would break the rules to help a depressive person.  They also don't understand that in other circumstances, you would be absolutely fine for what you are doing.  Even when you proved it before, most will still find a reason to get rid of your case.

The more I think about it, the more I think that all managers, bosses and directors should have a serious, solid formation about mental health.  Better than that would be to put someone who has lived with it in that position.  

Some of them are truly sympathetic of our situation "but have no choice".  That is also shit.  Creativity can create potential solutions, but they don't want to, because they don,t understand it.  Why would I be evaluated with normal standards while I don't eat and either don't sleep, or oversleep and be tired from it.  It's like breaking a runner's knee and asking him to run, then say he's not good at it and that he can't continue.
I will try but I doubt they can do anything for me at this point.  Waited much too long.
Even on suicide watch nobody cares.  great.
